description: This file defines an abstract Java class CacheManagerImpl that implements basic cache management functionality using Infinispan libraries. It includes methods for initializing a named cache, retrieving the cache manager, and accessing a TreeCache instance.

classes.name: CacheManagerImpl
classes.description: Abstract class providing cache initialization and access methods using Infinispan.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a TreeCache with a specified cache name, setting up batching and logging.

methods.name: getManager
methods.description: Returns the embedded cache manager instance.
